snippet.title: Mayday Vacay - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Mayday Vacay is a physics-based co-op adventure game where a relaxing boat trip turns into total chaos. Work together to sail, survive… and try not to sink your boat.

Wishlist on Steam 👇
